description: This PHP source file defines the 'LeaveType' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_leave_type' database table. It specifies properties such as ID, name, whether it is situational, deleted status, operational country, and leave entitlements, along with relevant getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Entity class representing different types of leave within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like ID, name, situational status, deletion flag, operational country, and related leave entitlements, with constructor and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave type.

methods.name: isSituational
methods.description: Returns whether the leave type is considered situational.

methods.name: setSituational
methods.description: Sets whether the leave type is situational.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the leave type has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deleted status of the leave type.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Returns the operational country associated with the leave type.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Sets the operational country associated with the leave type.
